newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ASC has 78 cent/share bid from AAOI.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ASC has 78 cent/share bid from AAOI.

text.p: Finance group ASC Ltd said on Tuesday it had received a 78 cent per share takeover offer from ASC All Ordinaries Index Fund Pty Ltd (AAOI).
AAOI said its cash offer should be attractive to ASC shareholders as the offer price represented a premium of 23.8 percent on ASC's closing price of 63 cents on December 31.
It said ASC would continue to be operated as an investment company "with a view to replicating the performance of the Australian All Ordinaries Index at the lowest possible cost".
The AAOI offer is subject to at least 51 percent acceptances and ASC shareholder approval for the sale of the ASC portfolio to GPG Group Plc for about A$26 million, among other things.
ASC would then have no assets other than cash, with a net asset value of not less than 79.27 cents per share.
